test_title: PYST 10: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: According to the author of the passage, which of the following is directly linked?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Cash transactions and black money**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explicitly states that "**cash transactions and black money are directly linked**."
 
• It highlights that cash transactions are difficult to track, which facilitates black money transactions.
 
• The government's effort to move towards electronic transactions is to make it easier to audit and curb illegal transactions.
 
• None of the other options mention a direct link between the given pairs in the context of black money.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Credit transaction and black money:**

 
 
• The passage does not establish any direct link between credit transactions and black money.
 
• Credit transactions are easier to audit, making black money less likely in this context.
 
 
 
• **Black and white money:**
 
 
• The passage does not discuss the relationship between black money and white money.
 
• The main focus is on the link between cash transactions and black money, rather than comparing black money with white money.
 
 
 
• **Cash and credit transactions:**
 
 
• Although the passage compares cash and electronic transactions, it does not state that they are directly linked in the context of black money.
 
• The emphasis is on cash transactions being harder to audit, which contributes to black money.
